note: CRON 2026-11-20: this file previously held a Yahoo Finance column that was wrong in the top half: Revenue printed 224.0 / 93.0 / 65.0 / 85.0 against the audited 259.0 / 181.7 / 169.8 / 154.1, and Operating Expenses 102.0 / 46.0 / 39.0 / 28.0 against the audited 23.0 / 13.9 / 13.7 / 9.6, with five values against four period labels. Every row is now read from the audited statements. Mapping, checked line by line: Revenue is the top rental line the issuer prints (Rental and related income, Rental income in FY2022); Cost of Sales is Direct property expenses; Gross Profit is Net rental and related income; Operating Expenses is Total administrative expenses; Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed Operating profit; Net Finance Costs is finance costs plus the fair value loss on derivative swaps and the convertible bond, plus exceptional loan fees and early termination costs, less finance income, so that Operating profit less Net Finance Costs equals the printed Profit before taxation in all four years; Income Tax is the printed Taxation charge (a credit of 1.2 in FY2023); Net Profit is Profit after taxation; EPS is the printed IFRS basic earnings per share in pounds (6.6p, 3.1p, 2.0p, 4.2p).
